claims: League of Legends is a free-to-play 5v5 MOBA.
MOBA stands for multiplayer online battle arena.
In League of Legends, teams fight to destroy the enemy Nexus.
League of Legends is available on PC (Windows/macOS).
League of Legends is available on PC and macOS.
Champions are categorized into roles like assassins, mages, tanks, supports, and marksmen.
League of Legends typically requires a 3 GHz processor.
League of Legends typically requires 4 GB of RAM.
League of Legends recommends 8 GB of RAM.
League of Legends requires modern NVIDIA/AMD graphics.
